title: PSB Vt 1 tugi: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics

metaDescription: PSB Vt 1 tugi is a lesser yam variety. About 35 days to harvest, 11.1 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits. Compare it with others.
excerpt: PSB Vt 1 is a registered tugi variety. The Philippine Seed Board approved it in 1990. It takes about 35 days from planting to harvest, with 11.07 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

**Yield:** 11.07 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: Key facts about PSB Vt 1 tugi
How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

PSB Vt 1 tugi takes about 35 days from planting to harvest. That is 17.7 days longer than the average of the 3 lesser yam varieties with a day count, 17.3 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 11.07 t/ha trails the average of its group, 12. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in the registry trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting.
Dry matter is 28.79 percent. A higher dry matter cooks mealy and gives processors more flour or starch from each tonne. The starch content is 20.39 percent.
Where and when to plant PSB Vt 1 tugi
Tugi is a hardy yam for backyards and uplands. Pick by tuber size and taste.

items: Buy sealed packs or tagged sacks from an accredited dealer, and check the packing date and germination rate.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Try it on a small area first, beside the variety you usually plant, before you switch the whole farm.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 35 days from planting to harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 11.07 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of PSB Vt 1?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
